releases.notes:
## Changed
* The calculator (default hotkey N) now acts as a browser for QMAW manual entries
  * The calculator can be switched between calculator mode and browser mode by pressing tab
* Added compatibility recipes allowing the sculk blocks from the sift backport mod (`io.github.derexxd.sift_backport`) to be processed in the rock mill
* The fluid burner can no longer be configured via the screwdriver
  * Instead, there's now a slider in the GUI, similar to the industrial combustion engine
  * The fluid burner can also accept overdrive upgrades
* The fluid burner's base heat capacity has been increased from 100k to 500k
* Added `findplayer` command to the spy satellite, allowing the coordinates from spotted players to be retrieved

## Fixed
* Fixed various dupes regarding the pneumatic storage network
* Fixed an exploit regarding the balefire bomb
* Fixed the fuel port being missing on the rotary furnace
* Fixed the redstone detection on the turbofan being offset outwards
* Fixed a crash caused by constructing a PWR with no working ports
* Fixed missing soyuz launch pad localization
* Fixed reasim RBMK auto control rods being unobtainable in 528 mode due to needing regular non-reasim control rods
* Fixed an issue where the recipe template files were almost never written with the icon stack
* Fixed electrolyzers leaving behind zombie power nodes causing connection issues even right after being placed
* Fixed legacy pile items being used in certain item pools

## Changed
* Updated various electric port textures
* Changed the custom material/autogen shape config structure
  * There can now be multiple molds per shape, allowing single and multi molds (like with 1x and 9x ingots)
  * Examples are now "custom metal demo" and "custom shape demo" instead of "bronze" and "gear" to avoid confusion
* Some common materials like tungsten, copper, aluminium and boron now have nugget forms
  * This allows foundry setups to use up materials with nugget precision

## Fixed
* Fixed recipe collision in the rotary furnace caused by a missing fluid type check, affecting the sodium aluminate and titanium tetrachloride recipes
* Fixed port offset on assembled machines

Daily updates will continue until the port situation is improved.

releases.notes:
## Added
* Rock mill
  * Earlygame post-steel crusher type machine
  * Can grind down various stones, gravel and sand into finer items while yielding byproduct
  * Mainly intended to serve as an easy way to automate/bulk craft certain elements in earlygame before BOP
  * While the byproduct chances are rather low and the recipe times are slow, the mills are easily scalable due to their low cost
  * Comes with convenient stacking frame
  * Ideal for skyblock/seablock type challenge runs, as it can be configured to serve as an Ex Nihilo substitute
  * Can also perform the sand and colloid to clay recipe of the acidizer, but at a lower efficiency
* Supercomputer
  * Does recipes involving data drives
  * Can calculate flight paths for orbital rockets and particle simulation data for fusion reactors
  * Can also process flight data which can be received from satellites
  * Most recipes have multiple variants with different cooling options
  * More expensive cooling makes the recipes faster, but more likely to fail
  * Can also create blueprint booklets without the aid of pufferfish, the recipe takes longer and much more energy, but has double the success chance
  * Can also create Klaus
* Space laboratory
  * New satellite that can provide data for drives
  * By default, can produce flight data which has to be written to a drive using a drive enclosure
  * The drive enclosure has to be placed onto one of the ground station's ports to receive data, which happens automatically if drive data is available
  * Accepts sensor relays, which produces orbital data
    * A single relay takes 100 hours to produce one drive worth of orbital data, this can be sped up by installing more relays on the same satellite
    * Time taken scales linearly, a satellite with 100 sensor relays only takes one hour per data drive
  * Accepts 0G assemblers, which allow items to be produced in space
    * More assemblers make the recipes run faster
    * Needed for the crystal circuit board
    * Input items have to be launched via rocket
* Lambda-98 rocket
  * New orbital rocket that is simpler to mass produce
  * The launch pad allows auto launch if the rocket is ready
  * Unlike the Soyuz, can neither deliver cargo nor use the orbital module
  * Uses peroxide as the oxidizer and gasoline as fuel (leaded to reduce engine knock)
* OpenComputers RTTY card
  * Tier 2 card that allows OC to interface with RoR directly
* Redstone over radio designator
  * Like a long range designator, but sends the aimed at position via RoR (coordinates separated by semicolon)
* Added new structures
  * Abandoned house with shelter (plains)
  * Military base (snowy biomes)
* Ilmenite
  * A raw ore chunk that can be extracted from titanium ore via centrifuging
  * Can be processed into titanium tetrachloride in a chemical plant
  * TiCl4 can either be processed in a rotary furnace using flux, or pyrolysis oven (latter option also recovers all used chlorine)
  * Ilmenite can also be arc smelted directly for lower efficiency but faster output (liquid smelting mode also yields iron byproduct)
* Pneumatic and exhaust pipe anchors

## Changed
* Updated russian, japanese and ukrainian localization
* The cargo elevator can now be controlled using RoR, allowing the platform to stop at certain heights
* Updated the pepperbox textures
  * The wood now looks more like wood and less like plastic
  * The bronze parts now have more depth
* Conveyor items being deleted due to cramming can now be configured with the server config `CONVEYOR_CRAM_MAX`, the default still being 25
* Conveyor belts being destroyed due to item cramming can now be configured with the server config `CONVEYOR_CRAM_EXPLODE`, it is still on by default
* Conveyor items will no longer break any belts, even with the config enabled, if the conveyor item entities have existed for less than one cram check cycle
